rows: Generally no tax benefits (except specific Govt rules)

items: PFRDA was initially constituted in 2003 by an executive order but gained statutory status under the PFRDA Act, 2013 (effective from September 2014).
Structure of PFRDA: Consists of a Chairperson and up to 6 members (minimum 3 whole-time members) appointed by the Central Government.
Jurisdiction for Appeals: Appeals against decisions of PFRDA go to the Securities Appellate Tribunal (SAT).

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: PFRDA regulates and promotes the pension sector in India to secure old age income security.
It mandates the registration and regulation of intermediaries such as Central Recordkeeping Agencies (CRAs), Pension Funds, and Trustee Banks.
PFRDA possesses civil court powers under the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, for summoning witnesses and inspecting books of accounts.
The Authority can conduct inquiries, issue cease-and-desist directions, and impose monetary penalties for regulatory non-compliance.
Appeals against orders passed by PFRDA are filed before the Securities Appellate Tribunal (SAT).
